keyEvents.text: First Half begins.
Goal! Willem II 0, PEC Zwolle 1. Sydney van Hooijdonk (PEC Zwolle) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the top right corner.
Goal! Willem II 1, PEC Zwolle 1. Hidde ter Avest (Willem II) right footed shot from outside the box to the bottom left corner.
Delay in match because of an injury Maxime Delanghe (Willem II).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
First Half ends, Willem II 1, PEC Zwolle 1.
Substitution, Willem II. Kasper Boogaard replaces Anass Zarrouk.
Second Half begins Willem II 1, PEC Zwolle 1.
Delay in match because of an injury Ryan Thomas (PEC Zwolle).
Substitution, Willem II. Jari Schuurman replaces Uriel van Aalst.
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Substitution, PEC Zwolle. Elias Sørensen replaces Gilles van der Wal.
Substitution, Willem II. Eser Gürbüz replaces Tonny Vilhena.
Vito van Crooij (Willem II) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, PEC Zwolle. Jan Bürger replaces Olivier Aertssen.
Substitution, PEC Zwolle. Thijs Oosting replaces Dylan Mbayo.
Substitution, Willem II. Thomas Verheydt replaces Vito van Crooij.
Substitution, Willem II. Mats Lemmens replaces Calvin Twigt.
Substitution, PEC Zwolle. Gabriel Reiziger replaces Younes Namli.
Substitution, PEC Zwolle. Nick Fichtinger replaces Ryan Thomas.
Second Half ends, Willem II 1, PEC Zwolle 1.
